name: Wakeari Musume no Joyuu Shigan ~Ojou-san, Kuru Toko Machigatte Imasen ka?~
original_name: 訳アリ娘の女優志願 ～お嬢さん、来るとこ間違っていませんか？～
source:
the story of Aoibashi Hazuki, a woman with a past who has entered the adult video industry, and how she is promoted by the protagonist, Shinmachi Atsuo, the president and director of an adult video production company is a manufacturer that specializes in orgies, so she decided to shoot a threesome from her debut work!

However, even though it's an orgy, she doesn't want to do things like group rape or other abusive scenes. She releases works that focus on the moment when a woman reaches climax, focusing on consensual sex. 

She will come up with an orgy situation that will make the most of Hazuki's talent, and create an extreme AV work that will strike a chord with orgy lovers!

One day, Aoibashi Hazuki, an aspiring actress, comes to his office for an interview. She's
20 years old and still a virgin. She's also beautiful, and a rare talent.
She desperately needs money, and it seems she's come here of her own volition.
Just to be sure, he recommends a major agency, but she replies, "I'm afraid I'll get lost in a place full of beautiful people..."

If she's thought it through and chosen this path of her own volition... Atsuo accepts her determination and gives her a "simple employment test"...

In this work, the "delicate distance" between the protagonist and Hazuki adds spice to the storyline.
At the request of Hazuki, who has no sexual experience, the protagonist gives her a lecture on sex and also becomes her partner for her first experience. After taking her virginity, the protagonist unconsciously begins to fall in love with her.

At first, he just wants to support her as a director and as a man, but as he watches her embraced by the AV actor, something begins to simmer inside him, and irritation grows. It's a jealousy that's similar to the feeling of having your lover stolen from you... His desire to raise her to become a popular AV actress and his feelings as a man who doesn't want to see her embraced by another man begin to intertwine.

During the filming, the male actor asks, "Who's bigger, your first partner or your first partner?" to which Hazuki replies, "You're bigger." Seeing this exchange of words, the protagonist is filled with burning jealousy. Situations like this, which resemble cuckolding, occur many times during filming.

While the filming is going smoothly, the protagonist is in a state of emotional turmoil. Let's see how his relationship with Hazuki will end!
translation:
讲述了有过去的女人青桥叶月进入成人视频行业，以及她如何被主角新町敦夫提拔的故事，成人视频制作公司的社长兼董事是一家专门从事狂欢的制造商，所以她决定从她的出道作品开始拍摄三人行！

然而，即使这是一场狂欢，她也不想做集体强奸或其他虐待场面的事情。她推出的作品聚焦于女性达到高潮的那一刻，聚焦于双方自愿的性行为。

她将发挥叶月的才华，想出一个狂欢场景，创作出一部引起狂欢爱好者共鸣的极限AV作品！

有一天，有抱负的演员青桥叶月来到他的办公室接受采访。她是20岁了，还是处女。她还很漂亮，而且是一个难得的人才。
她急需钱，看来她是自愿来到这里的。
为了保险起见，他推荐了一家大型经纪公司，但她回答说：“我担心我会迷失在一个充满美女的地方……”

如果她经过深思熟虑，自愿选择了这条路……厚生接受了她的决心，并给她做了一个“简单的就业测试”……

在本作中，主角与叶月之间的“微妙距离”为故事情节增添了趣味。
在没有性经验的叶月的要求下，主人公为她进行了性教育，并成为了她的第一次性经验的伴侣。夺取了她的童贞后，主角不知不觉地开始爱上她。

起初，他只是想支持她作为一个导演和一个男人，但当他看到她被AV演员拥抱时，他内心开始沸腾，越来越恼怒。这是一种类似于爱人被偷走的感觉的嫉妒……他希望将她培养成受欢迎的AV女演员，而他作为一个不想看到她被另一个男人拥抱的男人的感觉开始交织在一起。

拍摄过程中，男演员问：“你的第一搭档和你的第一搭档谁更大？”叶月回答说：“你更大了。”看到这样的对话，主角心中充满了强烈的嫉妒。这种类似戴绿帽子的情况在拍摄过程中多次出现。

拍摄进展顺利的同时，主角却陷入了情感的动荡。且看他与叶月的感情最终会如何收场！
